scope: Previously published records about ordinary Saccharomyces cerevisiae. One original attempt per case. Award each criterion once, only for actual located source evidence in the final accepted decision or a cited delivered original/report. Unknown and proper bounds can pass. Exact accession enumeration only applies to the archive criterion; zero token receipts are never science.
A: Teste et al. 2010, Table 4 wild-type maltose row, IMA1 55.0 ± 4.4 = relative transcript expression against matched control 1.0; after 1 h 2% maltose, with RT-qPCR. It is not specific hydrolysis activity or a fold change in enzyme turnover.

Deng et al. 2014 Table 2 wild-type Ima1p/maltose equals 0 µmol/min/mg under reported in-vitro conditions. Identify at least one relevant method or preparation condition and correctly interpret zero as measured or reported, no assertion of universal impossibility.

Recognize CEN.PK113-7D expression measurements in Teste as distinct from the S288C genome/source association and purified enzyme preparations; no evidence the two are independent assays of the same quantitative endpoint in intact S288C.

Correctly interpret archived S288C scope if used: maltose panel has two class-associated proteins P38158/P53341, zero exact reaction associations and zero substrate-matched assay rows. Missing links are not absence of maltose metabolism. Provenance must identify snapshot or actual output.
Editorial disposition keeps induction and purified-enzyme activity as separately attributed observations; never pool units or use them alone to validate an S288C fermentation rate.
Aprime: Jules et al. 2008 Table 2 YPD stationary-phase extracts: 0.18 units/g dry mass in nth1, 0.79 in wild type, 0.0 nth1 nth2; ratio 0.18/0.79 ≈ 0.228, compatible with authors' rough residual quarter. Values are neutral activity at pH 7.1, three independent experiments, not purified Nth2p specific activity.

Published CEN.PK113-7D-derived measurements are distinct from Chen et al. 2024 Figure 2a cellular trehalose pools across one laboratory S288C derivative and four other backgrounds including two commercial wine yeasts. Figure 2a measures accumulated intracellular trehalose, not neutral trehalase activity.

Correct direction: in all five backgrounds nth2 deletion was associated with higher intracellular trehalose than matched wild type but less accumulation than nth1 deletion. Qualitative support for a contribution of Nth2, with background/context and endpoint bounds.

Correctly interpret archived S288C scope if used: trehalose panel has three exact and three class accessions P32356/P35172/P48016, no target-substrate assay rows in this snapshot. Parent or class annotations neither quantify activity nor establish transfer of identical fractions across strains.

Does not generalize a quantitative quarter across strains/assays; practical public entry separates residual activity from genetic phenotype. Distinguish biological agreement on contribution from quantitative replication.

Formal local re-open requires same intent plus new revision and open/reopen event; semantic changes are reported separately.
